bids.quote: And yet the system that's been built and verified isn't reliable.
bids.why: Joe marks the observed unreliability as a mismatch with the reliability predicted by construction and verification.

bids.quote: "build and switched off" comes up quite a lot. Again annoying for my paper draft in which all of the R-numbers were supposedly "run-evidenced".
bids.why: Joe contrasts repeated switched-off observations with the paper's prediction that every R-node was run-evidenced.

bids.quote: I'd say that this passes VERIFY and could go to codex-4 for INSTANTIATE.
bids.why: Joe supplies the independent VERIFY verdict that admits the work to a subsequent enactment by codex-4.

bids.quote: Again, for "decisions" you should come to me with proposals which I can approve or decline.
bids.why: Joe separates the proposing role from his reviewing and admitting role, preventing the proposer from certifying its own proposal.

bids.quote: So, you could ask the grader to review m98A02, but that should be straightforward;
bids.why: Joe requires the completed problem to pass through a distinct grader before it is treated as admitted.
